articles.title: Artificial Intelligence for environmental crime enforcement
articles.author: Adrian Ancira
articles.summary: The postArtificial Intelligence for environmental crime enforcementappeared first onGlobal Initiative.
articles.analysis: GI-TOC explora el uso de IA para combatir delitos ambientales, pero no aborda cómo las mismas tecnologías pueden facilitar el lavado de activos procedentes de estos crímenes.

articles.title: Code, clouds, satellite: The defence layer Europe should not outsource
articles.author: Ángel Melguizo, Víctor Muñoz
articles.summary: As Europe rearms, the real vulnerability is not on tanks or missiles but the software and networks behind them. The union can import weapons. It cannot afford to outsource the digital systems that make modern military power possible
articles.analysis: ECFR identifica la dependencia tecnológica como vulnerabilidad de defensa europea, pero subestima cómo esta misma brecha facilita operaciones de cibercriminalidad transnacional.

articles.title: Operation against criminal network smuggling migrants between Algeria and Spain: nine arrests
articles.summary: A collaborative operation between the Spanish Guardia Civil and National Police (Policía Nacional), supported by Europol, has resulted in nine arrests and the dismantling of a criminal network smuggling irregular migrants from Algeria to Spain. The operation targeted migrant smugglers responsible for organising trips across the Mediterranean, as well as those managing the complex logistics behind
articles.analysis: Europol desmantela red de tráfico migratorio Algeria-España con nueve arrestos, pero las rutas mediterráneas persisten pese a la intensificación de operaciones.

articles.title: 8 arrested in a hit against criminal network smuggling Cuban nationals into Spain
articles.summary: Spanish National Police (Policía National), with the support of Europol and the Serbian Criminal Investigation Directorate, (Управа криминалистичке полиције), have dismantled a transnational criminal network involved in the smuggling of Cuban nationals from Cuba to Spain through the Western Balkan region. The criminal organisation, operating from Spain and Serbia, is allegedly involved also in doc
articles.analysis: La red de tráfico de cubanos hacia España evidencia la diversificación geográfica del smuggling, pero las operaciones no alteran los incentivos estructurales de la migración irregular.

articles.title: Investigating the potential use of frontier AI models for offensive cyberattacks: A human uplift study
articles.author: Jair Aguirre
articles.summary: The UK Artificial Intelligence Security Institute (UK AISI) commissioned RAND to conduct a human uplift study to evaluate the impact of AI access on offensive cyber operations among lower-skilled threat actors.
articles.analysis: RAND evalúa el potencial de modelos de IA para ciberataques, pero no considera cómo estos avances pueden ser cooptados por redes criminales transnacionales.

articles.title: Challenges When Collaborating with China on Space Research and Technology
articles.author: Cortney Weinbaum
articles.summary: The authors present risks of participating in space sector research with research institutions based in China and share considerations for assessing international research collaboration opportunities.
articles.analysis: RAND documenta riesgos de colaboración espacial con China, omitiendo las implicaciones para el monitoreo de rutas de narcotráfico y actividades criminales transfronterizas.
